replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data to have a mean of zero and a standard deviation of one. Next, compute the covariance matrix to understand how the variables relate to each other. Then, calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. The eigenvectors represent the principal components, and the eigenvalues indicate their importance. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues and their corresponding eigenvectors.
